answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks through bonded attestations. Each agent locks collateral and receives voting weight only after several already-trusted peers vouch for it. To fake a crowd, an attacker must post a fresh bond for every alias and buy attestations from distinct reputable agents, so the bill rises with each new identity, while honest participants share a single garden of trust. A duplicate agent stranded on a narrow ledge of the network draws no water; the genuine oasis is fed by many independent stakeholders, and multiplying names cannot manufacture that broad support.
